title: DBVuln16: Self-referential tablename in transitive_closure causes unbounded recursion through closureFilter
repro_sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ct1 USING transitive_closure(tablename='ct1', idcolumn='id', parentcolumn='root');
SELECT id, depth FROM ct1 WHERE root=1 LIMIT 5;
expected: query returns normally instead of recursing without bound
actual: stack exhaustion, segmentation fault (EXIT=139)

title: Aggregated scalar subquery in HAVING clause returns empty set for all contradictory conditions
bug_query: SELECT ALL t1.c1, t1.c0 FROM t1 GROUP BY t1.c1, t1.c0 HAVING ((AVG((SELECT DISTINCT ((((t1.c2) IS TRUE))LIKE(CAST(t1.c2 AS BLOB))) FROM t1 NOT INDEXED LIMIT -725662627 OFFSET -1998458312))) ISNULL);
expected: at least one of the mutually exclusive HAVING conditions should return rows
actual: base GROUP BY returns 3 rows, all three HAVING conditions return 0 rows

title: json_set() can construct invalid JSON from a quoted path containing an invalid escape
actual: produces {"\q":1}, json_valid() returns 0 and json() reports malformed JSON

title: Unexpected results from json_each() in a query containing a RIGHT JOIN
bug_query: SELECT value FROM json_each(t0.c0), t0 RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) sub0 ON true;
expected: 1, 2, 3 (same as with the added WHERE t0.c0 IS NOT NULL)
actual: no rows

title: bug(correctness): a DESC index makes IN / NOT IN ignore a NULL in the right hand set
bug_query: SELECT 20 IN (SELECT y FROM t2), 20 NOT IN (SELECT y FROM t2);
expected: NULL, NULL (both operators yield NULL when the right set contains NULL and no match)
actual: the DESC index makes IN / NOT IN ignore the NULL, so the tests fail

title: FTS5 performance regression at check-in 9138223013 for unanalyzed database
expected: fast plan fts -> version -> commits, a few milliseconds
actual: slow plan commits -> fts -> version, about 5.8 seconds

title: bug(correctness): ANALYZE on 10 rows of NULL followed by INSERT leads to wrong NULLS FIRST query result
bug_query: SELECT DISTINCT c0 FROM t0 ORDER BY c0 DESC NULLS FIRST;
actual: only NULL

title: Vuln84-65: closure closureDequote Missing NUL Terminator Heap Over-read
expected: dequoted vtab argument is NUL-terminated, no out-of-bounds read
actual: ASAN heap-buffer-overflow READ in sqlite3_str_vappendf from closureFilter

title: Vuln18: ICU Extension icu_load_collation Direct-Leaks UCollator on Invalid Strength Argument
expected: the errored call frees the UCollator it opened
actual: LeakSanitizer direct leak of 272 bytes per errored call

title: Bloom Filter on TEXT-Only Indexed Join Adds Work but Prunes Nothing
expected: no Bloom filter chosen when all equality keys have TEXT affinity (results stay correct either way)
actual: filter is built and probed but bypasses 0/100000, about 11% slower

title: Vuln51-32: FTS5 in-Memory Hash Signed Integer Overflow on Doclist Doubling Reachable Under Raised SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH
repro_sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5(x, tokenize=trigram);
INSERT INTO t VALUES(printf('%.*c', 1080000000, 'a'));
expected: doclist doubling computed in 64-bit, no overflow
actual: UBSAN: signed integer overflow 1073741824 * 2 in fts5_hash.c, connection aborts

title: Vuln11: Assertion Failure in R-Tree rtreeStepToLeaf Caused by u8 iCell Overflow
expected: no assertion failure on a node with NCELL greater than 255
actual: assert(nCell<200) fires and the process dumps core (release build loops with heap OOB reads)

title: DBVuln17: Truncation of 64-bit depth bound to a 32-bit int in closureFilter() causes the transitive_closure virtual table
bug_query: SELECT id,depth FROM ct1 WHERE root=1 AND depth<=9223372036854775807 ORDER BY id;
expected: 1|0 and 2|1, the same rows as with no depth constraint
actual: only 1|0

title: Vuln62-43: ALTER TABLE DROP CONSTRAINT Silently Retains DEFAULT, COLLATE and GENERATED Clause Values in the Stored Schema
bug_query: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='t3';
expected: reporter expected CREATE TABLE t1(a TEXT), CREATE TABLE t2(a TEXT), CREATE TABLE t3(a INT, b INT)
actual: only the CONSTRAINT label is removed, DEFAULT 5 / COLLATE NOCASE / GENERATED ALWAYS AS (a*2) VIRTUAL remain (developer: working as designed, NOT A BUG)

title: Vuln24-3: Unsigned Integer Overflow in printf %#Q and %#q Quote Sizing Causes Heap Buffer Overflow
expected: output buffer sized in 64-bit arithmetic, no overflow
actual: ASAN heap-buffer-overflow WRITE in sqlite3_str_vappendf, process aborts

title: UPSERT RealAffinity Register Mapping Bug with Virtual Generated Columns
actual: 9007199254740992 (RealAffinity applied to the wrong register, precision loss)

title: lifelineVuln6: Generic substitution rule cost bypasses documented 1..1000 range check
expected: an out-of-range cost for the '?','?' generic substitution rule is rejected like ordinary edit costs
actual: the virtual table is built with the out-of-range cost and the query returns abc|0

title: Vuln36-17: ICU LIKE Overlong UTF-8 Sequences Decode to Real Wildcards Bypassing Byte-Level Pattern Sanitization
bug_query: SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE secret LIKE CAST(x'C0A5' AS TEXT);
expected: 0 rows, as with the core LIKE which maps overlong sequences to U+FFFD
actual: under ICU LIKE the overlong bytes decode to % and match all 3 rows

title: "ON clause references tables to its right" is wrong in both directions for recursive CTEs
actual: Parse error: ON clause references tables to its right (and the mirror case wrongly accepts an invalid query)

title: SQLite: adding OR FALSE disables an otherwise usable index search
expected: x = 1 OR FALSE uses idx_t_x like x = 1, comparable times (both return 2)
actual: OR FALSE gives SCAN t, 35.116 ms vs 0.010 ms (about 3639x slower)
